0022600113.text: The Brooklyn Nets, who are 0-2 and 12th in the East, host the 1-1 Indiana Pacers in the Nets' third game of the 2026-27 season, with Brooklyn on a two-game losing streak and 2.5 games back of the Atlantic lead. Brooklyn is without Mikel Brown Jr., who is out with rest and is averaging 7.0 points and 19.9 minutes per game this season, and Tyler Bilodeau, who is out with a shoulder sprain. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), while Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with a hamstring strain and is a game-time decision; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was a 123-94 Nets loss in Brooklyn on April 9, part of a 2025-26 season series Brooklyn lost 1-2.
